readiness_inventory.conclusion: The repository contains extensive receipts and diagnostic reports but no universal journal contract. A pure unreferenced contract is required before any production journal, view, or export integration.

authority_rules: An inferred conclusion must carry INFERRED trust and at least one evidence reference.
An observed or derived fact cannot carry INFERRED trust.
A derived fact must cite at least one evidence reference.
The journal records diagnostic facts only and grants no mount, repair, route, storage, or owner authority.
redaction_rules: Sensitive field names are replaced with a fixed redaction marker.
Credential-like string values are replaced with the same marker.
Strings, arrays, object keys, and nesting depth are bounded.
retention_rules: Capacity is explicit, bounded from 1 through 4096, and defaults to 256.
Retention is explicit, bounded to 90 days, and defaults to 7 days.
Expired entries are pruned before accepted appends and after restore.
ordering_and_restart_rules: Observations beyond bounded future drift are rejected.
Exact duplicate event identifiers are idempotent.
Conflicting duplicates are rejected without mutation.
Snapshots validate identity, configuration, sequence, time, entry fingerprints, and aggregate checksum before restore.
fail_passive_rules: Invalid append input does not mutate entries.
Invalid snapshot restore preserves the prior journal.
Rejections are bounded and expose only code and field.
The pure contract performs no storage, network, DOM, route, repair, or user-data effect.

coverage: string, array, key, and depth bounds
zero storage, network, DOM, route, repair, and user-data effects
